content: .{@-द्वन्द्व@} {%a.%} .²1 indifferent in regard to opposite pairs of feelings (pleasure or pain), neither glad nor sorry; निर्द्वन्द्वो निर्ममो भूत्वा चरिष्यामि मृगैः सह <ls>Mb. 1. 85. 16</ls>; निर्द्वन्द्वो नित्यसत्त्वस्थो निर्योगक्षेम आत्मवान् <ls>Bg. 2. 45</ls>. .²2 not dependent upon another, independent. .²3 free from jealousy or envy. .²4 not double. .²5 not contested, undisputed. .²6 not acknowledging two principles.
